title: Faithful flatness of henselization to base completion
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subset A$ an ideal, and $\eta:A\to H$ the colimit of the full category of etale $A$-algebras $B$ with bijective canonical $A/I\to B/IB$ [lem-weil-pbc-pair-henselization]. Put $J=IH$. Suppose $\theta:\widehat A_I\xrightarrow{\sim}\widehat H_J$ is a ring isomorphism of adic completions [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] such that, for every $n\geq0$, $x\in\widehat A_I$ and $a\in A$, $x_n=a\bmod I^n$ implies $(\theta x)_n=\eta(a)\bmod J^n$. Then the map $\gamma:H\to\widehat A_I$ given by the completion map followed by $\theta^{-1}$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].

mathlib_searches.query: For a Noetherian pair the map from its henselization to its adic completion is faithfully flat
faithful flatness of the completion map from the henselization of a Noetherian pair

proof.text: Use pair_henselization to obtain essential smallness, filteredness, a henselian colimit vertex and the quotient isomorphism. The unique under-category colimit isomorphism commutes with the base structure map; map_map carries the extended ideal, map_jacobson_of_bijective carries its Jacobson bound, and quotientEquiv carries the quotient isomorphism to the specified vertex.

For each etale stage B, HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff gives Algebra.Etale A B. Its finite-presentation instance gives finite type, and Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing gives Noetherianity. The smooth flat instance gives flatness of A to B.

Apply bijective_quotientMap_pow_of_flat and pair_henselization_completion_data to obtain a completion equivalence alpha for each stage. For b in B and each coordinate n choose a representative a of the nth coordinate of alpha inverse of the completion image of b. Its compatibility and the given theta compatibility identify both images in the henselization completion. Apply the quotient map induced by the coprojection and AdicCompletion.ext_evalₐ to identify gamma composed with the coprojection with alpha inverse composed with the completion map. Completion flatness for Noetherian B and flatness of ring equivalences make this composite flat.

Reindex by equivSmallModel, whisker the cocone along its inverse and forget the under-category structure; these operations preserve the filtered colimit. Transport to the chosen colimit by the unique ring isomorphism and apply flat_of_flat_comp_colimit_ι to the stagewise flat composites. Compose with the inverse transport to obtain flatness of gamma.

Compose first-coordinate evaluation with the quotient factor from A/I^1 to A/I. The theta compatibility proves that composing gamma with this map and the transported quotient equivalence Q gives the quotient map H to H/J. Every maximal ideal m contains J by the Jacobson bound. Its image mQ in H/J is proper by surjectivity and containment of the quotient kernel. The ideal m.map gamma is contained in the comap of mQ under Q composed with evaluation, which is proper. Module.faithfullyFlat_iff, using Ideal.smul_top_eq_map, proves the conclusion.

lean.statement: theorem pair_henselization_completion_faithfullyFlat (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) (c : Cocone (ObjectProperty.ι (fun C : Under (CommRingCat.of A) ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map C.hom) ∧ Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map C.hom.hom) C.hom.hom (Ideal.le_comap_map))))) (hc : IsColimit c) (θ : AdicCompletion I A ≃+* AdicCompletion (I.map c.pt.hom.hom) c.pt.right) (hθ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : AdicCompletion I A) (a : A), AdicCompletion.evalₐ I n x = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) a → AdicCompletion.evalₐ (I.map c.pt.hom.hom) n (θ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I.map c.pt.hom.hom) ^ n) (c.pt.hom.hom a)) : RingHom.FaithfullyFlat (θ.symm.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap c.pt.right (AdicCompletion (I.map c.pt.hom.hom) c.pt.right)))
